contract.status: User clarified Symbiote attaches to another race and Raksasa gives another race giant size; each requires one additional race spin.
contract.dispatch: Every selected host/base family executes its normal approved events, including another authorized attachment/origin chain. Commit family to shared history BEFORE children.
contract.identity: The wrapper component stays owned. Host/base is a linked descendant in the same Hybrid root when applicable, not a replacement result or an extra Hybrid root.
contract.order: Working execution order: resolve host/base immediate events before returning to the attachment caller. Symbiote then runs its existing Takeover/power chain. Raksasa registers its existing stage effects once and returns after its base chain.
contract.mastery: All early powers survive main None and use the one shared character rank; caller-scoped Authority max remains an exception. No host-specific mastery bonus inferred.
contract.return: Always restore the saved nested caller. Only initial outer Race completion advances to the Archetype gate; attachments acquired inside Mutant restore its mutation event without a second gate or Archetype spin.
contract.exclusion: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
contract.termination: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (19 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
contract.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
contract.idempotence: One host/base invocation per actual wrapper source component; committed history, links, effects and child keys restore together on resume.
contract.context: Record wrapper source, actual host/base and each nested descendant. Do not reveal unrolled host or final Size/Takeover results in earlier reaction.
